pages.title: Nick the Santa Squishmallow with a Sack of Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Nick carries a sack of wrapped gifts in this printable coloring page. A pom-pom hat, curled mustache, and wide belt buckle define his round Squishmallow shape.

pages.title: Rudolph the Squishmallow Pulling a Christmas Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: Rudolph pulls a sleigh with two bundled Squishmallows in this printable coloring page. His branching antlers rise above a round nose, and a short harness links him to the sleigh.

pages.title: Carol the Christmas Tree Squishmallow with a Star Topper Coloring Page
pages.description: Carol the Christmas Tree smiles in this printable coloring page, with a five-pointed star at the top, three scalloped tiers, and round ornaments spread across her branches.

pages.title: Manny the Snowman Squishmallow with a Carrot Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: Manny the Snowman wears a top hat and scarf in this printable coloring page. A short carrot nose and two round buttons sit inside his broad, rounded outline.

pages.title: Gina the Gingerbread Squishmallow with Icing and a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Gina the Gingerbread Squishmallow wears a bow beside her icing fringe in this printable coloring page. Three round buttons and wavy icing stripes decorate her body.

pages.title: Elliot the Elf Squishmallow Wrapping Christmas Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: Elliot the Elf wraps a Christmas present in this printable coloring page, with a striped parcel between his hands and a tape dispenser and scissors on the table.

pages.title: Ruby the Reindeer Squishmallow with Jingle Bells Coloring Page
pages.description: Ruby the Reindeer wears a collar of three jingle bells in this printable coloring page. Rounded antlers, a spotted forehead, and an oval belly frame the bells.

pages.title: Snowman Benny the Bigfoot Squishmallow Coloring Page
pages.description: Snowman Benny has a top hat, a carrot nose, and a striped scarf in this printable coloring page. His shaggy outline ends in two feet with rounded toe pads.

pages.title: Cam the Cat Squishmallow Peeking Out of a Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: Cam the Cat peeks over a fluffy stocking cuff in this printable coloring page. Two paws rest on the trim above a snowflake and curved heel and toe patches.

pages.title: Omri the Christmas Ornament Squishmallow on a Pine Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: Omri the Ornament sits among pine needles in this printable coloring page. A rounded hanging loop tops the plush, and a snowflake decorates its band of circles.

pages.title: Clarice the Squishmallow Reindeer with a Christmas Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: Clarice poses behind a Christmas wreath in this printable coloring page. A bow sits beside her ear, and another tops the wreath among berries and holly leaves.

pages.title: Bumble the Squishmallow Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: Bumble grips a striped candy cane in this printable coloring page. Shaggy fur surrounds his face, with two small fangs below his smile and a broad belly patch beneath the cane.

pages.title: Hermey the Elf Squishmallow with Earmuffs Coloring Page
pages.description: Hermey wears fluffy earmuffs in this printable coloring page, with swept hair above his round face, a pointed hat, and a buckle centered on his elf outfit.

pages.title: Jen the Penguin Squishmallow Ice Skating by a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Jen the Penguin glides on one skate in this printable coloring page. A knit hat and fringed scarf frame her face, and a decorated tree stands beside the ice.

pages.title: Brooke the Polar Bear Squishmallow in a Winter Hat and Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: Brooke the Polar Bear bundles up in this printable coloring page, wearing a pom-pom hat and a wide striped scarf above the round belly of her plush body.

pages.title: Jordan the Gingerbread Squishmallow at a Gingerbread House Coloring Page
pages.description: Jordan the Gingerbread Squishmallow sits in front of a gingerbread house in this printable coloring page. Icing trims his arms and body, while candy shapes surround the doorway behind him.

pages.title: Adela the Nutcracker Squishmallow on a Christmas Mantel Coloring Page
pages.description: Adela the Nutcracker sits on a mantel in this printable coloring page, wearing a plumed hat and buttoned uniform. A small tree and wrapped present flank the plush.

pages.title: Guri the Christmas Gnome Squishmallow with a Pointed Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Guri the Christmas Gnome wears a tall pointed hat in this printable coloring page. Snowflakes decorate the hatband, and a rounded nose sits above his scalloped beard.

pages.title: Falala the Fawn Squishmallow with a Snowflake Coloring Page
pages.description: Falala the Fawn holds a snowflake between two paws in this printable coloring page. Small spots cross her forehead above rounded ears and a two-part face patch.

pages.title: Dawn the Fawn Squishmallow Wrapped in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Dawn the Fawn is wrapped in two strands of Christmas lights in this printable coloring page. Large bulbs curve across her belly below small antlers and forehead spots.

pages.title: Archie the Axolotl Squishmallow Dressed as a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie the Axolotl peeks from a snowman costume in this printable coloring page. Frilly gills stick out beside a top hat, striped scarf, and three round buttons.

pages.title: Fifi the Fox Squishmallow with a Snowflake Coloring Page
pages.description: Fifi the Fox has a snowflake centered on her belly in this printable coloring page. Pointed ears and angular cheek markings frame the fox's round face.

pages.title: Patton the Peppermint Cow Squishmallow with Swirl Candies Coloring Page
pages.description: Patton the Peppermint Cow sits behind a row of swirl candies in this printable coloring page. Small horns, a broad muzzle, and a spiral belly patch define the plush.

pages.title: Ernesto the Peppermint Latte Squishmallow with Whipped Cream Coloring Page
pages.description: Ernesto the Peppermint Latte smiles in this printable coloring page, with whipped cream and a striped candy cane rising above a handled mug with a peppermint emblem.

pages.title: Hans the Hedgehog Squishmallow as a Gingerbread Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Hans the Hedgehog appears as a gingerbread ornament in this printable coloring page. A hanging loop crowns the scalloped outline, and wavy icing frames his bow and buttons.

pages.title: Samir the Whale Squishmallow Ornament with a Trapper Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Samir the Whale wears a trapper hat in this printable coloring page. The ornament has a hanging loop, fluffy earflaps, and a visible tail beside the striped belly.

pages.title: Chip the Beaver Squishmallow in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Chip the Beaver wears a pom-pom Santa hat in this printable coloring page. Two front teeth show below his whiskers, and a crosshatched tail rises beside his body.

pages.title: Benny the Bigfoot Squishmallow in a Sparkly Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Benny the Bigfoot wears a Santa hat with three outlined sparkles in this printable coloring page. Shaggy fur frames his face and two broad feet with toe pads.

pages.title: Tuxedosam the Penguin Squishmallow in a Holiday Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Tuxedosam wears a holiday hat in this printable coloring page, with a rounded beak, a bow tie, and two flippers beside his large oval belly.

pages.title: Hello Kitty Squishmallow with a Christmas Present Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty holds a Christmas present in this printable coloring page. Her signature ear bow sits beside a Santa hat, and a wide ribbon crosses the gift box.

pages.title: My Melody Squishmallow with a Christmas Cookie Tray Coloring Page
pages.description: My Melody holds a tray of Christmas cookies in this printable coloring page, including a gingerbread figure, a star, and a tree beneath her floppy ears and bow.

pages.title: Kuromi Squishmallow with a Bat Shaped Christmas Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Kuromi holds up a bat-shaped ornament in this printable coloring page. Her skull emblem sits below the Santa hat, and round bells trim her pointed collar.

pages.title: Cinnamoroll Squishmallow by a Christmas Cocoa Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinnamoroll holds a snowflake mug at a Christmas cocoa stand in this printable coloring page. Long ears frame a striped scarf, with candy canes and a jar on the counter behind him.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Decorating a Tree Together Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat on a step stool hangs an ornament in this printable coloring page. A fox holds another bauble while an owl sits beside a box of decorations.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Around a Fireplace with Stockings Coloring Page
pages.description: Five Christmas Squishmallows gather around a fireplace in this printable coloring page. Three stockings hang above the flames, and a round wreath sits on the mantel.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows in a Snow Globe with a Tiny Cabin Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas Squishmallows group fills this printable coloring page inside a snow globe. A cabin and snowy firs rise behind the plush faces, above a large bow on the base.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Singing Carols by a Lamppost Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Squishmallows sing from open songbooks in this printable coloring page. A bow hangs from the lamppost above them, and knit hats and scarves fill the snowy scene.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Mailing Letters to Santa Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox slips a letter into Santa's mailbox in this printable coloring page. The other Squishmallows hold heart-sealed envelopes beside the post and its large Christmas bow.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Riding a Sled Down a Snowy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Four Christmas Squishmallows ride downhill on a sled in this printable coloring page. Curved runners cut through the snow as a scarf and antler headband stand out above the rails.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Building a Snowman with a Top Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Squishmallows build a snowman in this printable coloring page. A cat and fox steady the top hat while two friends hold snowballs below the twig arms.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Wearing Matching Holiday Pajamas Coloring Page
pages.description: Four Christmas Squishmallows wear matching pajamas in this printable coloring page. Rows of little fir trees cover their buttoned tops, beside a window and a decorated tree.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows Opening an Advent Calendar Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Squishmallows crowd around an advent calendar in this printable coloring page. One door opens to a tiny wrapped gift, and a big bow tops the grid of flaps.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows at a Candy Cane Arch Coloring Page
pages.description: Five Christmas Squishmallows gather beneath a striped candy cane arch in this printable coloring page. A large bow tops the arch and a scarf-wearing mushroom sits in front.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows on a Holiday Train with Presents Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas train carries Squishmallows and wrapped presents in this printable coloring page. A cat rides in the locomotive, with bows decorating the wagons behind it.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows at a North Pole Toy Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Squishmallows work at a North Pole toy bench in this printable coloring page. A toy locomotive, a rocking horse, and a spool of ribbon fill the workshop.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows at a Holiday Market Stall Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat tends a Christmas market stall in this printable coloring page. Candy canes and gifts fill the counter, and a fawn holds a snowflake bag in front.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows at an Ugly Christmas Sweater Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Squishmallows wear patterned sweaters in this printable coloring page. A gingerbread figure, snowflake, and crossed candy canes decorate their outfits beneath strings of holiday lights.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows on a Merry Christmas Card Coloring Page
pages.description: A folded Christmas card features three Squishmallows in this printable coloring page. A scalloped border surrounds the plush friends, with holly, a bow, and bells framing them.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows in a Wreath with a Big Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Five Christmas Squishmallows fill a wreath in this printable coloring page. Holly clusters ring the group, and a large ribbon bow crosses the bottom of the wreath.

pages.title: Christmas Squishmallows in a Holiday Ornament Pattern Coloring Page
pages.description: Six Squishmallow faces appear inside separate ornaments in this printable coloring page. Round and pointed baubles alternate across the pattern, with small stars between the two columns.
